title: Set up the booking rules
summary: Check availability, block times outside office hours, filter doctors by service and create the appointment right on the calendar.

steps.title: Calendar settings
steps.details: They're each user's preferences: they save automatically when changed and apply right away.

steps.title: Check availability
steps.details: When creating/editing an appointment, checks that the time is available for the chosen doctor or room.

steps.title: Block outside office hours
steps.details: Dims and blocks the times outside office hours on the calendar (according to schedules and exceptions), so appointments can't be created there.

steps.title: Filter doctors by service
steps.details: When creating an appointment, filters the doctor list to show only those who provide the selected service.

steps.title: Create the appointment on the calendar
steps.details: Clicking a slot creates the appointment right on the calendar with a card, without opening the dialog. The Create button always opens the dialog.

steps.title: Preview the appointment while creating it
steps.details: The inline appointment card opens next to the appointment, which shows on the calendar while you fill it in, so you can see how it fits in the gaps. Changing the date moves the calendar to that day. Tablet and desktop only.
